name: Newcastle University crystallography platform: two Formulatrix Rock Imager 1000 (MRC infrastructure grant; 2023)
brief: A university structural biology platform buys two automated crystal-hotel imagers (visible and UV optics) to incubate and image crystallisation trays at two temperatures, replacing an obsolete imager.

cost.original: GBP 797,524 (UKRI/MRC award MC_PC_MR/Y000781/1, 2023-24); USD at about 1.24 USD/GBP (approximate conversion)
cost.excludes_note: Grant value may include software, installation or contingency not itemised; a matching university investment for a Shifter is separate.

notes: Out-of-sample round 2: collected blind after the model was frozen at commit 973d0f5. includes corrected from ['instruments'] to ['analytics', 'instruments'] after scoring, by the rule that a purchase of named equipment covers those items' cost categories (the round-2 collection prompt omitted the category convention). Out-of-sample (oos2 set), found after the cost model was frozen; not used for catalog prices. price_basis=configured (two units with visible+UV optics and software). Quote: "We propose to purchase two Formulatrix Rock Imager 1000 'crystal hotels' ... Each unit is equipped to visualise crystals by visible and UV light". Verified 3 Oct 2026 via GtR API funds value 797524 GBP. Conversion rate is my estimate, so USD is uncertain by a few percent; the figure may be higher than pure hardware.
